src7.text:
The Wrenmoor Bell Ringers' Tower Society keeps two towers on its books. Holy Trinity has a ring of 12 bells, and its tenor weighs 318 kilograms. St Bartholomew has a ring of 15 bells, and its tenor weighs 1609 kilograms.

The society's standard reference lists the method Stedman Triples, which is classed as plain.

On 2025-02-22, a peal of the Bristol Surprise Major was rung at St Michael and All Angels and ran for 185 minutes. Priya Kendrick-Lowe conducted and called the changes, while Eleanor Varga-Thorne organised the band as leader. The booking fee was 3500 AUD in minor units.

Practice-night records for St Bartholomew show two ringers. Harriet Benwell attended on 2025-07-17 and rang for 3 hours; the coaching note reads "Practise covering on the tenor". Samuel Okonedo attended on 2024-06-27 and rang for 4 hours; no coaching was given that night.
